sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the timeline
sections.what: Loads the layout pieces, icons, date helpers, theme, shared UI parts and the timeline store.
sections.why: The date helper turns stored date text into readable headings.

sections.name: EVENT_CONFIG
sections.title: Event type look-up
sections.what: Maps each kind of event, such as lab result, vital, medicine start or diagnosis, to its icon, color and short label. Unknown types use a generic look.
sections.why: Reason not stated beyond the labels. It gives each event type its own look.
sections.watch_out: Event type names must match the server exactly. A new or renamed type falls back to the generic look without any warning.

sections.name: TimelineScreen (part 1)
sections.title: Loading events and grouping by date
sections.what: Asks the store for events when the screen opens and whenever the filter changes. Then it groups the events under a heading for each date.
sections.why: Grouping by day makes a long history easier to scan.
sections.watch_out: The Meds filter includes only prescription events, so medicine start events do not appear under it.

sections.name: TimelineScreen (part 2)
sections.title: Event list and filter bar
sections.what: Draws the title, the search button, the filter chips, and the dated list. Each event card shows an icon, title, label, description and time, plus a pin for pinned events. It also shows a loading spinner and an empty message when there are no events.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. The layout matches a dated history design.
sections.watch_out: The search button has no action, so tapping it does nothing yet.

sections.name: TimelineScreen (part 3)
sections.title: Bottom spacer and screen close
sections.what: Adds empty space at the end of the list so the last event is not hidden behind the tab bar.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the last card above the bottom tab bar. Reason not stated in the code.

sections.name: FilterChip
sections.title: Filter button and timeline styles
sections.what: Draws one filter chip button and sets the look of the header, cards, date headings, connecting lines and empty message.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. The chip is defined here and used only by this screen.
sections.watch_out: The connecting line uses fixed offsets and a special case for the last item, so it may look slightly off on some screen sizes.

summary: The Health Timeline screen, which lists the user's health events by date, with filters for reports, vitals and medicines.
purpose: Gives a dated history of medical events so the user can scan their health journey.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the subtitle. Events come from a shared store.
how: When the screen opens, and whenever a filter changes, it asks the store for events. The events are grouped under a heading for each date. Each event shows an icon, a label, a title, a description and a time. Filter chips narrow the list, and pulling down reloads it.
inputs: Events from the timeline store, filter taps, and pull to refresh.
outputs: A grouped, scrollable list. Nothing is saved.
risks: The Meds filter includes only prescription events, so medicine start events are missed. The store's more-pages flag is read but never used, so long histories cannot be loaded page by page here. The search button does nothing.
debug: If events are missing, check the event type names against the look-up table and the active filter. If dates look wrong, check the date text from the server. If the list is empty, check the store's loading state.
